en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a sloping village market square with a central stone fountain. Several children stand near the fountain in the foreground. Traditional multi‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs line the square; forested hills and fields appear in the background. Printed red caption text identifies the scene as the market of Lauenstein in the Saxon Erzgebirge. Publisher information is printed along the bottom margin.
